title: The End of Oak Street Reveals Surprise Anime Crossover For Opening Weekend
content:
While films like Spider-Man: Brand New Day and The Odyssey are still tearing up the box office charts, this doesn’t mean that other movies aren’t attempting to carve a path of their own in theaters this weekend. One of the biggest newcomers is The End of Oak Street , a film starring Ewan McGregor and Anne Hathaway as they struggle with their neighborhood being teleported to a prehistoric era. In a wild crossover, an unexpected anime has been teamed up with this time-traveling family in a way that many might not have seen coming, following the anime’s recent theatrical return.

To help celebrate The End of Oak Street’s arrival in theaters, the anime franchise Girls und Panzer has released a new collaboration video that shows the anime’s cast reacting to the dinosaur invasion from the Warner Bros picture. The anime franchise usually didn’t see its cast taking on dinosaurs with their vehicles of war, though this fact didn’t stop the young teens from adding commentary to the prehistoric setting. Hilariously enough, the anime adaptation brought back several members of the girls’ voice cast to help promote McGregor and Hathaway’s film. Following the recent Girls und Panzer film series that ended earlier this year, aka Girls und Pazner: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu , a new anime project has yet to be confirmed, though it’s clear Japan has not forgotten the franchise from the video below.

Girls & Dinos In Tanks

Girls und Panzer is a wild anime franchise , as there isn’t any other anime franchise out there that has quite the same premise. For those who might not have heard of the series, it first began as a manga in 2012 by creator Ryohichi Saitaniya, as it followed its young protagonists who lived in a world where driving tanks was commonplace. Ever since the first chapter dropped, the franchise wasted little time expanding its universe via countless manga and anime spin-offs, routinely following protagonist Miho Nishizumi as she takes part in her school’s “tank-based sports.”

Ironically enough, this crossover makes sense when you consider the moves that Warner Bros Discovery has been making in recent years . The WB has made it no secret that the studio has been investing far more into the anime industry, creating originals of its own while also helping to release classic series that fans have been waiting for. While this is far from a confirmation that fans should count down the days until The End of Oak Street receives its own anime adaptation, the film entering a world where anime girls drive tanks proves how Warner Bros is willing to smash together unlikely stories. With Warner Bros set to merge with Paramount, it will be interesting to see what the merger might mean for WB’s anime endeavors down the line.

title: Disney+ Announces Cast for Live-Action Webtoon-Based Series A Man's Man
content:
Disney+ unveiled the cast lineup on July 28 for A Man's Man , the live-action series based on the webtoon of the same name.

Jeong-min Park will star as Yoo-hyun Han, with Sung-woo Bae, Ji-hyun Kim, Moon-sung Jung, Sang-hoon Moon, and Min Kim playing members of his product planning team. The cast also includes Jung-eun Lee, Dae-myung Kim, Sang-yi Lee, and special appearances by Seol-hyun Kim and Kwang-soo Lee.

Hee-won Kim, who previously helmed the Disney+ series Light Shop , will direct the series.

Originally created as a web novel by Lucas, A Man's Man was adapted into a webtoon in 2020 and was serialized on Naver Webtoon. The story follows Yoo-hyun Han, an ordinary office worker who rises to become a powerful CEO — only to lose everything in his relentless pursuit of success. After finding himself transported back to his youth during a job interview, he embarks on a second chance at life, confronting regrets and striving to rewrite his future.

With more than 470 million global views, A Man's Man has been translated into English, Japanese, Indonesian, Thai, and other languages. It has particularly resonated with Japanese readers on LINE Manga, where it earned the No. 1 spot in the human drama genre.

The English version of illustrator Dogago's webtoon is available on WEBTOON . There is currently no official English translation of the web novel.

title: The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup Kesshō Member Ketteisen Anime Reveals Promo Video, More Cast, September 30 Premiere
content:
The staff for Shin Tennis no Ōji-sama U-17 World Cup Kesshō Member Ketteisen ( The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup Finals Members Decisive Match), the sequel anime to The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup Semifinal ( Shin Tennis no Ōji-sama U-17 World Cup Semifinal ) anime, unveiled a new promotional video, visual, four cast members for Spain's national team, and September 30 premiere on Friday. The trailer previews the opening theme song "Walls And Bridges" by four-member unit Aozu .

The newly announced cast includes (pictured above from left to right):

• Tasuku Hatanaka as Julio Roman

• Reiji Kawashima as Mars de Colón

• Ryūho Nagaoka as Silva Serra Banbieri

• Megumi Han as Sedah

The sequel anime will depict the battle to decide who will represent Japan in the finals match against Spain. Film actor Yū Shirota (Kunimitsu Tezuka in The Prince of Tennis live-action film) voices the character Romeo Fernandez from Spain.

The four-member unit Aozu composed of Ryōma Echizen (voiced by Junko Minagawa ), Kunimitsu Tezuka (voiced by Ryōtarō Okiayu ), Syusuke Fuji (voiced by Yuki Kaida ), and Shuichiro Ōishi (voiced Takayuki Kondō ) is performing the opening theme song "Walls And Bridges." Keigo Atobe (voiced by Junichi Suwabe ) and Yūshi Oshitari (voiced by Hidenobu Kiuchi ) are performing the ending theme song "Kinkanshoku phenomenal" (Annular Eclipse phenomenal).

The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup premiered on TV Tokyo in July 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and also streamed an English dub . The anime was the first new television anime in the franchise in about a decade.

Crunchyroll describes the series:

When tennis phenom Ryoma Echizen is kicked out of Japan's elite U-17 training camp for breaking the rules, he's despondent. But a stroke of good luck hits when he's able to try out for the U.S. team. Proving himself against their hardened veterans isn't going to be easy, and if he is accepted, he'll have to play against his former friends. Can he help his new brothers smash their way to victory?

The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup Semifinal debuted in October 2024. The anime centers on the Japan vs. Germany semifinal, and is itself a sequel to The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup anime series.

Takeshi Konomi serialized the original manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 1999 to 2008. The manga follows middle school tennis player Ryōma Echizen as he battles rivals to reach the national tournament. The manga inspired a 2001-2005 television anime, two anime feature films and a theatrical short, various video anime projects , a live-action film , a live-action television series in China, and a popular stage musical series.

Konomi launched The New Prince of Tennis sequel manga in Shueisha 's Jump Square magazine in 2009. Shueisha published the manga's 47th compiled book volume on June 4. Konomi announced in July 2025 that he plans to end the serialization of The New Prince of Tennis within a year.

title: Naver WEBTOON Cooperates With Korea's MCST, Interpol to Take Down 3 English Webtoon, Manga Piracy Sites
content:
Naver WEBTOON announced on August 13 that three major English-language websites illegally distributing webtoons and manga have been taken down through cooperation with South Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism; INTERPOL; and law enforcement authorities in North Africa. The operators of the sites were also arrested. Naver WEBTOON did not reveal the names of the websites.

The three sites, which were operated by the same group in North Africa, targeted audiences in the United States, Europe, and other Western markets. They were found to have illegally scanned and translated more than 300 popular webtoons.

According to Similarweb data, the three sites collectively received more than 130 million visits annually, with more than 20 million visits recorded over the past three months.

Naver WEBTOON 's Anti-Piracy team had monitored the sites and gathered evidence of copyright infringement after multiple existing sites were consolidated and rebranded under new domains in an apparent attempt to evade enforcement. The company provided information and evidence to authorities, leading to the international investigation and subsequent takedown.

The sites reportedly served as primary sources for unauthorized scans and translations that were later redistributed across other piracy websites. The operators are currently undergoing legal proceedings in the local jurisdiction.

title: Disney+ Releases Made in Korea Season 2 Live-Action Show's Prequel Webtoon
content:
Disney+ announced on July 31 that it has released a three-episode prequel webtoon for its live-action series Made in Korea on Kakao Page .

Set in the turbulent 1970s, Made in Korea follows Ki-tae Baek (Hyun Bin), a Central Intelligence Agency agent who leads a double life as a smuggler at night, and prosecutor Geon-young Jang ( Woo-sung Jung ), who becomes determined to stop him.

The upcoming second season, scheduled to debut on September 9, takes place nine years later and follows Baek as he pursues greater ambitions.

The webtoon bridges the two seasons, depicting events from the nine-year period that led Baek toward the center of power. It also explores changes and shifting relationships among key characters whose stories are not fully covered in the two seasons.

The webtoon features artist Lee Mugi, creator of the webtoon I Am a Sinner , which will itself receive a Disney+ series adaptation next year.

Currently an English version of the webtoon is not available. The live-action series is available on Hulu .

title: Pokémon Pokopia Game Crosses 5 Million Units Sold Worldwide
content:
The game's paid Expansion Pass DLC added the underwater Bubbly Basin town on August 5 as part 1 of the pass. The game will add accessories in late 2026 as part 2 and another town in 2027 as part 3. Purchasing the DLC gives players a bonus Dynamic Ditto print recipe and bonus Rare Pokémetal in-game. The free update that launched with part 1 of the DLC included new Pokémon such as Manaphy, Popplio, Mudkip, Chinchou, Lanturn, Buizel, Corphish, Totodile, Dhelmise, Golisopod, Corsola, Frillish, Lumineon, and Sharpedo.

The free update adds the ability for players to explore and build underwater in existing towns using the new ability to Dive.

The game launched for Nintendo Switch 2 on March 5 with a Game-Key Card release. Game-Key Cards are physical cartridges that do not actually contain a game, but rather, a key to unlock and play the digital version from Nintendo 's eShop. Koei Tecmo developed the game.

The game introduces Professor Tangrowth, Peakychu, Mosslax, and Smearguru. They are variations of Tangrowth, Pikachu, Snorlax, and Smeargle, respectively.

The battle-focused game Pokémon Champions launched on iOS and Android on June 17. The game debuted for Switch on April 8.

The new Pokémon Winds/Waves games will launch for Switch 2 worldwide in 2027.

title: 'Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru II' Unveils Additional Cast Pair, Fourth Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shigeru Sagazaki 's Katainaka no Ossan Kensei ni Naru ( From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman ) light novel unveiled an additional pair of cast and a fourth promotional video for the second season on Friday. The anime series premiered on July 8 at 11.45 p.m. on TV Asahi, followed by AT-X and BS Asahi.

Voice actors Kensho Ono ( Jigokuraku ) and Sumire Uesaka ( Shunkashuutou Daikousha ) are joining the cast as Warren Flumvelk and Shueste Flumvelk, respectively.

Akio Kazumi ( Hitoribocchi no Isekai Kouryaku ) is directing the anime at Passione and Hayabusa Film . Kunihiko Okada ( Seiken Gakuin no Makentsukai ) is handling the series composition. Satsuki Hayasaka ( Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki ) is designing the characters and serving as the chief animation director. Yasuharu Takanashi ( Tsuki ga Michibiku Isekai Douchuu ) is composing the music.

Produced by Passione and Hayabusa Film, the first season aired for 12 episodes in Spring 2025. Amazon Prime Video is streaming the anime series worldwide.

Sagazaki began writing the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in November 2020. Square Enix began publishing the light novel under its SQEX Novel imprint in April 2021, with illustrations by Tetsuhiro Nabeshima ( Inu to Hasami wa Tsukaiyou ). The 11th volume was released on August 6.

A manga adaptation by Kazuki Satou began in Young Champion magazine in August 2021. Akita Shoten published the ninth volume on June 26.

J-Novel Club licensed the light novel in English in October 2023. The tenth light novel volume went on sale on August 10. Yen Press licensed the manga in March 2024. The fifth manga volume was released on April 28, with the sixth volume scheduled to be released on September 22.

title: Deadline: Disney+ Cancels New Power Rangers Series
content:
Percy Jackson and the Olympians showrunners Jonathan E. Steinberg and Dan Shotz were brought on to produce the show. Hasbro would have also produced the show.

Power Rangers Dino Fury , the latest series in the Power Rangers franchise , premiered on Nickelodeon in February 2021. The series is based on, and repurposes footage from, Kishiryū Sentai Ryūsoulger . The show's second season debuted on Netflix in March 2022. The third season, titled Power Rangers Cosmic Fury , debuted on Netflix in September 2023.

Netflix streamed the Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Once & Always 30th anniversary special in April 2023.

Digital Eclipse and Hasbro released the Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Rita's Rewind game digitally for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam , and Nintendo Switch in December 2024.

title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 2 Anime Reveals New Promo Video, More Cast
content:
NBCUniversal Japan revealed a fourth promotional video on Friday for the second anime season based on Shigeru Sagazaki 's From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman ( Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru: Tada no Inaka no Kenjutsu Shihan Datta noni, Taisei Shita Deshitachi ga Ore o Hōttekurenai Ken ) light novel series.

The company additionally revealed two more cast members:

Kenshō Ono as Warren Flumvelk

Sumire Uesaka as Shueste Flumvelk

The new season debuted in the "IMAnimation W" programming block on TV Asahi and its affiliated channels throughout Japan on July 8 at 11:45 p.m. (10:45 a.m. EDT). The anime also airs on AT-X and BS Asahi . Amazon Prime Video started exclusively streaming the anime worldwide on July 9 at 12:15 a.m (July 8 at 11:15 a.m. EDT).

Previously announced new cast members include:

• Takashi Kondō as Hanoy Cressa

• Hiromu Mineta as Kuriu Rybark

• Mami Uchida as Prim

• Hiroshi Yanaka as Morris Pasyushka

The anime's returning staff include Akio Kazumi ( Loner Life in Another World , Fist of the Blue Sky Regenesis ), who is again directing the series at Passione and Hayabusa Film . Kunihiko Okada ( The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy , By the Grace of the Gods season 2) is back in charge of series scripts, Satsuki Hayasaka ( The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy , Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki ) is returning to design the characters, and also returning as chief animation director. Yasuharu Takanashi ( Baki Hanma vs. Kengan Ashura , Fairy Tail ) is again composing the music.

Rock band Unicorn performs the opening theme song "Kurenai no Ha" (Crimson Leaf). BLUE ENCOUNT performs the ending theme song "Mikansei" (Unfinished).

The anime's first season premiered in April 2025, and is streaming exclusively on Amazon Prime Video worldwide.

Sagazaki launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in November 2020. Square Enix is publishing the novel volumes with illustration by Tetsuhiro Nabeshima .

J-Novel Club licensed the novel series and describes the story:

Beryl Gardinant, a self-proclaimed “humble old man,” is a sword instructor at his dojo in a rural, backwater village. In his younger years, he dreamed of glory as a master swordsman, but those days are long behind him. Out of the blue, he receives a visit from a famous former pupil who brings him world-shattering news—he's been appointed as special instructor for the knights of the Liberion Order! With his life now turned upside down, Beryl travels to the capital and reunites with some of his former students: elite knights, an ace wizard, and even an adventurer who's attained the highest guild rank possible. But why do they all want his tutelage?! As far as he's concerned, they clearly don't need him anymore. Can Beryl live up to his new position? And will he ever get a moment's peace away from his adoring students?!

Kazuki Satō launched the novels' manga adaptation in Akita Shoten 's Dokodemo Young Champion magazine in August 2021. Yen Press releases the manga in English. The franchise also has two spinoff manga.

Hiroshi Yanaka as Morris Pasyushka

The anime's returning staff include Akio Kazumi ( Loner Life in Another World , Fist of the Blue Sky Regenesis ), who is again directing the series at Passione and Hayabusa Film . Kunihiko Okada ( The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy , By the Grace of the Gods season 2) is back in charge of series scripts, Satsuki Hayasaka ( The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy , Yatogame-chan Kansatsu Nikki ) is returning to design the characters, and also returning as chief animation director. Yasuharu Takanashi ( Baki Hanma vs. Kengan Ashura , Fairy Tail ) is again composing the music.
Rock band Unicorn performs the opening theme song "Kurenai no Ha" (Crimson Leaf). BLUE ENCOUNT performs the ending theme song "Mikansei" (Unfinished).
The anime's first season premiered in April 2025, and is streaming exclusively on Amazon Prime Video worldwide.
Sagazaki launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in November 2020. Square Enix is publishing the novel volumes with illustration by Tetsuhiro Nabeshima .
J-Novel Club licensed the novel series and describes the story:

Beryl Gardinant, a self-proclaimed “humble old man,” is a sword instructor at his dojo in a rural, backwater village. In his younger years, he dreamed of glory as a master swordsman, but those days are long behind him. Out of the blue, he receives a visit from a famous former pupil who brings him world-shattering news—he's been appointed as special instructor for the knights of the Liberion Order! With his life now turned upside down, Beryl travels to the capital and reunites with some of his former students: elite knights, an ace wizard, and even an adventurer who's attained the highest guild rank possible. But why do they all want his tutelage?! As far as he's concerned, they clearly don't need him anymore. Can Beryl live up to his new position? And will he ever get a moment's peace away from his adoring students?!

Kazuki Satō launched the novels' manga adaptation in Akita Shoten 's Dokodemo Young Champion magazine in August 2021. Yen Press releases the manga in English. The franchise also has two spinoff manga.

title: Kenpachi, Hitsugaya, and Byakuya Fight in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 44 Preview
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 4 (Episode 44 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes.

The anime premiered early in US theaters with the first three episodes. The fourth episode is titled “THE PERFECT CRIMSON,” and it will premiere on Saturday, August 15. You can see the synopsis and preview images below.

Even with Kenpachi, Hitsugaya, and Byakuya fighting together, they cannot overcome Gerard’s “Miracle.” Driven by pure battle instinct, Kenpachi charges at Gerard, but every time Gerard’s “Sword of Hope” is chipped, it triggers yet another “Miracle,” gradually turning the tables and pushing Kenpachi into a corner. Meanwhile, in the throne room, Ichigo endures Yhwach’s relentless assault while searching for a chance to turn the battle around.

ALSO READ: Interview: Ichigo Voice Actors Masakazu Morita and Johnny Yong Bosch Talk BLEACH BLEACH JET Artbook and Ryogo Narita’s School Life Novel Return, Fan Vote and 2027 Exhibition Announced

BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 44 Staff:

• Screenplay: Masaki Hiramatsu

• Storyboard: Jeong Yeong-hoon

• Animation Director: Jeong Yeong-hoon, Mika Okubo, HAN SEUNGAH, Kazumi Inadome, Kazuo Takigawa, Liu Minxuan

• Chief Animation Director: Kumiko Takayanagi

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.
